briefing.headline: AMD slides 8.13% as tech sector shows mixed overnight moves
briefing.summary: The overnight session saw a split among the major tech mega‑caps: AMD and TSLA posted double‑digit declines, while AMZN, MSFT, AAPL and NVDA were modestly up or down. Broad market ETFs (SPY, QQQ) barely moved, indicating limited directional bias. Smaller or niche tokens such as XMTR, SIBN and CLVT rallied over 18%, whereas PARA, DOX and SUPN collapsed sharply, reflecting a very uneven breadth. Overall the market opened with mixed sentiment ahead of the US opening.
